type: array of value- or branch-identified card choice objects
default: generated value labels or branch titles for every enum or oneOf choice
effect: customizes a matching card label, translation prefix, disabled state, safe presentation content, selected content, and branch detail without changing stored choice identity
precedence: current Control option only; enum values take precedence over oneOf branches; each entry must identify one existing value or branch, and the first valid entry wins when an identifier is duplicated; invalid entries are ignored with author diagnostics
